How this is built. Every role is scraped directly from the company's own hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable), then classified by how much technical background it needs, the tools named in the description, salary, visa sponsorship, and how long it has been open. No reposts, no staffing-agency spam, no Indeed.
